question: A flight travels a distance of 1,200 km in 3 hours. What is the speed of the flight?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct formula for Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Speed = 1200 ÷ 3

Speed = 400 km/hr

**∴ The correct option is C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Distance traveled by flight = 1200 km

Time taken = 3 hours

Formula Used:

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

 
• Start End FLIGHT 1200 km 3 hours Speed = 1200 ÷ 3 

Calculations:

⇒ Speed = 1200 ÷ 3

⇒ Speed = 400 km/hr

**∴ The correct option is C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

To convert Speed from km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. If a journey is divided into two equal distances with speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the same direction, Relative Speed = S₁ − S₂. When they move in opposite directions, Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂.
